title: Styling link underlines
summary: Thicker, offset underlines with text-decoration, a clear hover, and a visited-safe colour.
explanation: Links are underlined by default and that is good: colour alone is not enough for people who cannot tell the colours apart. Instead of removing the line, style it. text-decoration-thickness makes it heavier and text-underline-offset moves it down so it clears letters like g and y.
text-decoration-color can differ from the text, so the line is a soft orange at rest and darkens on hover. Keep the hover change obvious, and give keyboard users the same cue with :focus-visible.
The nav links drop the underline because their position already says they are links, and they get one back on hover.
tryThis: Remove text-underline-offset: the line touches the descenders.
Change text-decoration-thickness to from-font: it uses the font's own line.
Set text-decoration: none on .prose a: the links are now hard to spot in the paragraph.
